R1.name: Range 1 (Volatility Consolidation)
R1.conditions: Price touches/tests 09:30 AM open print for 4 or more hourly blocks during RTH (09:30-16:00 ET). Both bullish & bearish breakouts fail.
R1.tactical_rule: Turn ON mean-reversion cash-flow scalps; target 10 basis points.

DNP.name: Directional No Pullback (Pure Trend Continuation)
DNP.conditions: Price moves away from 09:30 AM open for 5 or more hourly blocks without breaking preceding hourly highs (downtrend) or lows (uptrend). Hourly 50% midpoints respected.
DNP.tactical_rule: Turn ON trend continuation models (buy dips / sell rips). Counter-trend stops get plumbered.

DWP.name: Directional With Pullback (Trend-to-Range Transition)
DWP.conditions: Explosive move away from 09:30 AM open in morning (first 45-90 mins), never returns to open print, then transitions into afternoon consolidation (11:00-14:00 ET) taking out hourly highs/lows.
DWP.tactical_rule: Trade early momentum, then switch to range-bound strategies after 11:00 AM.

R2.name: Range 2 / Reversion (Trend Failure)
R2.conditions: Starts as explosive trend away from 09:30 AM open, but collapses after 11:30 AM and reverts completely back to 09:30 AM open price. Visual 'thigh gap'.
R2.tactical_rule: Fade extreme boundaries back to open price.

LT.name: Long True
LT.conditions: Variable phase expands above Fixed Constant High and does not breach Fixed Constant Low. Hourly closes stay above 50% midpoints.

LF.name: Long False
LF.conditions: Variable phase sweeps above Fixed Constant High, then undergoes structural failure and closes below morning prints.

ST.name: Short True
ST.conditions: Variable phase expands below Fixed Constant Low and does not breach Fixed Constant High. Hourly closes stay below 50% midpoints.

SF.name: Short False
SF.conditions: Variable phase sweeps below Fixed Constant Low, then reverses and closes back above morning prints.

sequential_streaks.true_streak_rule: 2 or 3 True days in a row -> 90% probability of False Day on Day 3 or Day 4 (expect early sweep/reversal).
sequential_streaks.false_streak_rule: 6 False days in a row -> High-probability True Day on Day 7.
sequential_streaks.weekly_ema_miss_multiplier: If Week 1 misses Weekly EMA excursion target, Week 2 hit rate multiplies to >98% (misses 2 weeks in a row only 1 in 56 weeks).
